_comment: Text models for the built-in engine (AI-7, provider `embedded`): GGUF files run by the bundled llama-server. Same rules as models.json: an entry with pending_pin true has no pinned checksum yet, so it is hidden from the AI page and every action on it is refused until the maintainer fills in url (pinned to a commit), file, sha256, bytes, ram_mb, license and context_tokens and removes the flag. The three entries below are PLACEHOLDERS for the 8 GB, 16 GB and 32 GB memory tiers; the model choice is made by the maintainer's research (spike S8), nothing here names a real model or a real file. tier_gb is the smallest Mac memory the entry is meant for; ram_mb is the memory the model needs while it runs (file plus context cache), in MB; context_tokens is the context the engine starts it with; license must be Apache-2.0 or MIT. To use another mirror or revision, put a file of this shape at <config dir>/ai/text/catalog.json or point CAPTUREMANN_TEXT_CATALOG at one: it replaces this list.

models.label: Built-in model for 32 GB Macs and more
